{{Quote|One of the Three fell ill. Deadly. Only I could save. Davel-Ka said I could not heal. His vision forbade it.|[[Writings of Medo-Ja]]|<ref name="Imp March of Time" />}}
'''Davel-Ka''' was a [[Voss Mystics|Voss Mystic]] living on [[Voss]] many years before the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was discovered by the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] society. He had a vision that prevented a great healer [[Medo-Ja]] from helping a dying member of the [[Three]].
